fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM101,750. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057146/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Matriculation or Foundation or its equivalent with a minimum CGPA 2.00 out of 4.00; OR STPM or its equivalent with a minimum of 2 full passes with GP 2.00; OR A Diploma or its equivalent with minimum CGPA 2.00 out of 4.00; (Note: All the above qualifications need to be supported with at least credits in Mathematics and Science and a pass in English at SPM level); OR A Diploma in Psychology with minimum CGPA 2.00 out of 4.00; OR Any other qualification recognized as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia.
